custom_expected:
Step 3: Customer name displays on the WO header (data reference visible).
Step 5: Customer name displays on the invoice. The customer record's standalone page is unreachable, but customer references on records the user CAN see are still displayed.
custom_preconds: Test user: Customer Management View OFF, Work orders View ON, Invoicing and Payments View ON, See Financial ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in. Confirm Customers absent from top nav.
2. Top nav > Work Orders. Open a WO for a known customer.
3. Inspect the WO header for the customer name.
4. Open the invoice for the same WO.
5. Inspect the customer name on the invoice.
title: Customer name remains visible on related records (WOs, invoices) when Customers nav is hidden
